texts.facts: The learned APP on instructions of the Food Safety Officer, Nagpur submits that in terms of provisions of Section 38(1) (c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, necessary bond with an undertaking would be taken from the applicant herein.
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the applicant has pointed out order passed in Criminal Writ Petition No.2/2019 (Tushar Subhash Getam & Others Vs. The State of Maharashtra) by the Aurangabad Bench of the Bombay High Court.
